21 CFR 82.1336(a) (eCFR, binding, verbatim): (a) The color additive D&C Red No. 36 shall conform in identity and specifications to the requirements of § 74.1336 (a)(1) and (b) of this chapter [1].
21 CFR 82.1336(b) (eCFR, binding, verbatim): (b) All lakes of D&C Red No. 36 shall be manufactured from previously certified batches of the straight color additive [2].
21 CFR 82.1050 (eCFR, binding, verbatim): A batch of a straight color listed in this subpart may be certified, in accordance with the provisions of this part, for use only in drugs and cosmetics, if such batch conforms to the requirements of § 82.5 and to the specifications set forth in this subpart for such color [3].
